description_en: Local residents refer to this Caitya asTaḥ Gaḥ Bhawāndyaḥ.According to H.Śākya’s(1993, 82) classification, this Caitya is a Vajradhātu Caitya. The Caitya has niches on its eastern, southern, western and northern sides which contain stone statues of Akṣobhaya, Ratnasambhava, Amitābha and Amogasiddhi respectively. The stone inscription attached to the western platform has been severely damaged. The Caitya has aguṭhīthat consists of five members from the Jyapū community. They have been taking care of the monument and conduct its yearly religious activities.
description_ne: उपत्यकामा पाइने विभिन्न शैलीका चैत्यमध्ये यस शैलीको चैत्यलाई हेमराज शाक्यले (१९९३, ८२) ‘वज्रधातु चैत्य’ भनेका छन् । स्थानीयले भने बोलीचालीमा यसलाई तःगःभवान्द्यः भन्दै आएका छन् । परम्परागत मान्यता अनुरूप चैत्यको पूर्वी गवाक्षमा अक्षोभ्य, दक्षिणमा रत्नसम्भव, पश्चिममा अमिताभ र उत्तरमा अमोघसिद्धिको शिलामूर्ति स्थापित छ । चैत्यको पश्चिमी पेटीमाथि एउटा शिलापत्र खडा छ जसको अधिकांश भाग खिइसकेकाले पढ्न सकिएन । चैत्यसँग सम्बन्धित निजी गुठी अस्तित्वमा छ जसमा ज्यापु समुदायका पाँच सदस्य आवद्ध छन् । जग्गाको आयस्ता पनि भएको उक्त गुठीले चैत्यसँग सम्बन्धित वार्षिक कर्मका साथै चैत्यको रेखदेख गर्दै आएको छ ।
monument_assessment: Heavily damaged (collapsed, demolished, major cracks and structural damages)
references: Sources and references Sources Member of the guṭhī , Maharjan, male, age 63

historical_events.event_description: Minor repairs were carried out by theguṭī-members in 2004 CE. The Caitya was cleaned and its cracks were filled with plaster.

An inscription is embedded on the west-facing facade of the Caitya. The surface is badly damaged and only a few characters are still legible. The text that can be read is not helpful in interpreting the original text.
